descriptions.w3d_s20_acquire_two_entries_80171ee0: Appears to reuse or request the pool entries at offsets 40 and 36 of the owner for the given count and return zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_acquire_sized_8018d5b8: Appears to output half the byte span between two fields, notify a helper and acquire a pool entry of twice that count when enabled.
